title: What I eat in a day: king cobra

scenes.kicker: What I eat in a day
scenes.headline: Healthy, high-protein, very on-brand
A whole python. Meal prep is everything.
King cobras mostly eat other snakes
scenes.body: Their genus name, Ophiophagus, literally means 'snake-eater'. At up to 5.6 m, it's also the world's longest venomous snake.

caption:
Diet culture, but make it reptile.

King cobras almost exclusively prey on other snakes, and scientists now recognise four species of king cobra. The lunch photo was taken in Kaeng Krachan National Park, Thailand.

Source: Britannica (King cobra).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Parody of the 'what I eat in a day' influencer format, played straight by a king cobra; the hauls are real wild photos and the punchline is the snake-eating diet.
